answer: Proof-of-replication deters Sybil attacks by requiring each agent vertex to hold a uniquely sealed data replica verified through timed Merkle challenges. Because replica-specific encoding blocks deduplication across identities, an attacker incurs the verifiable cost of dedicating physical storage capacity per fake node, even for lightweight agents indexing falcon sightings or quill archives. However, wholesale datacenter pricing lets wealthy operators subsidize large identity clusters.
